summary.what_it_is: Lobby gives a business an AI concierge on its website instead of a static page. The concierge greets every visitor, answers questions about that specific business using only material the owner supplied, steers toward one goal the owner picks, and hands the business a qualified lead with a suggested reply.
summary.who_it_suits: Owner-operated and small service businesses whose website is a brochure and whose enquiries arrive as scattered phone calls, WhatsApp messages and unanswered forms.
summary.who_it_does_not_suit: Businesses needing deep integration with an existing CRM or booking system today, high-volume ecommerce support, or anything requiring the concierge to take payment.
summary.agent_story: Every Lobby concierge exposes the same knowledge twice: as a chat for the human visitor, and as WebMCP tools for the AI agent that visitor brings. A business installs one script and becomes usable by both without writing any tool schemas itself.

plans.name: Free
features: Boundaries: control what it will and won’t say

conversation_definition: One visitor session, however many messages it contains. A visitor who asks eight questions is one conversation.
overage: Nothing bad, and never a surprise charge. On the paid plan you get a buffer past your allowance and an email letting you know. Your concierge keeps working the whole time. If you need more, a pack of 100 extra conversations is $15, one click, one-off. We will never auto-charge you for going over.

setup_options.name: Embed on an existing website
setup_options.when_to_use: The business already has a website and wants the concierge to appear on it as a floating launcher.
steps: Create a concierge at lobby.host/signup — email address only, no card.
Describe the business, or paste its website URL and let Lobby read it.
Copy the one-line script from the dashboard.
Paste it before the closing </body> tag on every page of the site.

setup_options.name: Hosted concierge page
setup_options.when_to_use: The business has no website, or wants a single shareable address that is the concierge rather than a page with a concierge on it.
steps: Create a concierge at lobby.host/signup — email address only, no card.
Share that link. It works as the business’s whole web presence.
